EDO STATE (PSI 8.7): Edo Endorses OMO-SHINE Digital Health Tool, Launches Orientation Week, and Partners UBTH on Oxygen Plant
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.6): Gov. Otti Grants ₦1m Relief for Xenophobia Returnees, ₦2m for Bereaved Families, and Enforces Ebola Prevention

OGUN STATE (PSI 8.4): Gov. Abiodun Projects Economic Boom via Eba Island Oil Discovery and Gateway Deep-Sea Port
KWARA STATE (PSI 8.3): Gov. AbdulRazaq Flags Off 21km Oke-Oyi/Lanwa Road and Inaugurates ICAAF Visual Arts Centre
BAYELSA STATE (PSI 8.1): Gov. Diri Chairs 201st SEC, Receives NAGGMDP Medical Award, and Warns Against Inflammatory Politics
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 8.0): Zamfara Allocates Fire Trucks across LGAs and Partners UNICEF on Multi-Sectoral Resilience in 4 LGAs
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 7.8): Gov. Sule Highlights Human Capital and Land Digitalization Strides at 32nd Nigerian Economic Summit
ENUGU STATE (PSI 7.8): Gov. Mbah Reaffirms Church Partnership in Smart Green Schools Drive and Receives Canon Law Award
RIVERS STATE (PSI 7.6): Gov. Fubara Charges Traditional Rulers on Neutrality and Peace Ahead of 2027 Political Season
OYO STATE (PSI 7.5): Gov. Makinde Commissions CapitalSage Headquarters on 10th Anniversary in Ibadan
EKITI STATE (PSI 7.4): Ekiti Awards ₦3.25m Cash and Laptops to Youth Essay Competition Winners for Ekiti@30

LAGOS (PSI 9.3): Received CMA CGM Group executives to expand Lekki Deep Sea Port operations, addressed the NBCC Executive Business Breakfast, co-hosted CANEX 2026 preparations, and DSVA launched SGBV prevention with 70 fathers.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.1): Gov Otu presented the ₦987.8b 2027 Budget (₦708b capital), inspected cowpea export and 91-ha soybean sites under Project Grow, assessed obstetric health equipment, and convened peace talks for Ebom-Ebijakara.

PLATEAU (PSI 8.8): Gov Mutfwang opened the 11th Jos Trade Fair, announcing a permanent complex, a 500-cattle daily abattoir, an industrial park MoU with Chinese investors, and BPO training for 1,800 youths; Agro Rangers deployed for harvest protection.

EDO (PSI 8.7): Endorsed OMO-SHINE app for zero-dose child tracking, launched ESOA Orientation Week across security and media agencies, discussed UBTH takeover of state oxygen plant, and distributed 10k educational materials.

ABIA (PSI 8.6): Gov Otti approved ₦1m each for 130 xenophobia returnees, ₦2m each for families of deceased victims, activated Week 43 Ebola control protocols, and secured 2 sexual assault convictions via Nchedo Centre.

DELTA (PSI 8.6): Gov Oborevwori signed 5 reform bills into law including Revenue Service Consolidated Law 2026 and 13th-Month Salary Law 2026, and presented a 99.99-hectare C of O to Olam Agri for an animal feed plant.

GOMBE (PSI 8.5): Gov Inuwa Yahaya convened the Gombe@30 International Conference, commissioned 6 VIP residences, visited the bereaved Adamu family in Jekadafari, reviewed ACReSAL work plans, and Yamaltu-Deba LGA flagged off out-of-school re-enrollment.

OGUN (PSI 8.4): Gov Abiodun addressed Ijebu-Ode stakeholders, assuring a new Awujale before May 2027 and projecting economic growth from Eba Island crude oil discovery, Gateway Deep-Sea Port, and Blue Marine SEZ.
KWARA (PSI 8.3): Gov AbdulRazaq flagged off the 21km Oke-Oyi/Lanwa road and Oke Ose/Maya Asunlope road, and commissioned the ICAAF Visual Arts Centre with a Fela Kuti exhibition.
BAYELSA (PSI 8.1): Gov Diri chaired the 201st SEC meeting, received NAGGMDP Exemplary Leadership Award for upgrading 49 health facilities, and warned politicians against provocative statements.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.0): Zamfara Fire Service allocated new fire trucks to Gusau, Shinkafi, Kaura Namoda, Talata Mafara, and Gummi LGAs; Ministry of Information partnered UNICEF on resilience in 4 LGAs.
NASARAWA (PSI 7.8): Gov Sule participated as a panelist at NES #32, highlighting achievements in health sector human capital, youth jobs, industrial attraction, and GIS land registration.
ENUGU (PSI 7.8): Gov Mbah addressed the 38th Canon Law Society Convention, assuring Church leaders Smart Green Schools complement mission education, offering training for mission teachers.
RIVERS (PSI 7.6): Gov Fubara opened the 126th-128th Combined Quarterly Meeting of Rivers Traditional Rulers Council, urging royal fathers to remain neutral and preserve domain peace.
OYO (PSI 7.5): Gov Makinde commissioned the headquarters of CapitalSage Holdings in Ibadan during its 10th anniversary, reiterating state support for fintech, agribusiness, and FMCG investments.
EKITI (PSI 7.4): Ekiti State Government presented ₦3.25m cash prizes and laptops to winners Peace Ogunjemilua, Blessing Adelusi, and Ayomide Lafiaji in the Ekiti@30 Youth Essay Competition.
